responsibility: Application lifecycle facade, deterministic frame pumping and trace, explicit platform service composition, and injected time-port ownership.

lifetime.creation: App::Init creates ApplicationPlatformServices and its TimePort in the explicit composition root, then transfers that ownership into ApplicationRuntime
lifetime.shutdown: Quit is a request; Stopped is reached at a frame boundary or explicit runtime shutdown, then RAII destroys ApplicationRuntime and its owned platform services

threading.concurrency: Run owns the loop while active; PumpFrame is rejected during Run; the injected TimePort is advanced only on the application owner thread

invariants.text: App initializes without SDL, Vulkan, ImGui, APaint, scene, or game dependencies.
Quit is a request and becomes Stopped only at the canonical safe frame boundary.
PumpFrame cannot execute while Run owns the application loop.
Headless manual pumping produces deterministic frame and lifecycle trace ordering through the public SDK.
ApplicationRuntime receives time through owned injected platform services, advances the TimePort exactly once per pumped frame, and does not advance it at a quit-only safe boundary.
